title: Evaluating Muscle Function After Ankle Surgery
brief_summary: Patients who are forced to rest or reduce activity as a result of illness, injury, or surgery often experience resulting muscle weakness. This study will evaluate muscle features and muscle strength in patients who are recovering from surgery for broken ankles. The goal of this study is to improve the recovery of muscle function and overall ability after prolonged periods of ankle inactivity due to surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 5 to 10 weeks of cast immobilization following surgery (ORIF) for mallerolar fracture

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breastfeeding
* Severe claustrophobia
* MRI incompatible metal implants (e.g., pacemaker)
* Diabetes or peripheral neuropathies
* Bleeding disorders
